method: seed i (i = 0, 1, …) is lo + (first 8 bytes of SHA-256(label + "/" + i), big-endian) mod (hi − lo + 1); skip repeats and excluded sets; stop at count
label: dreamteam/v0.2/eval-holdout-1
protocol: The seeds are not listed anywhere in the repository; they are regenerated from this method and must match seedsSHA256.

No harness runs a holdout seed: eval.GuardRepo refuses them, sealed or not, without naming them. Only the canonical runner (internal/sim TestHoldoutRun) runs them, with a protocol authorized by eval.Authorize.

eval.Authorize needs docs/evaluation/holdout-unseal.json (dreamteam.holdout-unseal/v1), committed by the owner named as its approver, naming this holdout and this manifest's SHA-256, the policy and its digest, the strategy set and its digest (which pins every strategy file's), the exact engine, the one primary strategy and the approval date; every one of those files committed with no change.

Before unsealing: the strategies are frozen from development seeds 901-910 only (1001-1020 are exposed and reference-only), the policy is confirmed by the owner, the whole corrected framework has had one independent review, and the strategy set's files are committed.

The runner runs every strategy of the set, the no-action baseline included, on all 40 seeds to one common horizon, evaluates them with the frozen policy, and commits run.json (every record's digest) and report.json to docs/evaluation/holdout-runs/v0.2-holdout-1/, once.

A rerun is allowed only to reproduce the same bytes (same engine, policy, strategies); one that differs fails and writes nothing. Any change to a strategy, the policy or the engine after unsealing makes the holdout exposed: its results become reference-only, and a new holdout must be generated with a new label.
